title: Header integrity field: general floor function pinned by LIVE TRACE; per-frame crc8-poly premise refuted by ground truth
device: EP4CE10 / cycloneive1 / Quartus 21.1.0 Build 842 uncompressed .rbf; validation image <target>.rbf
method: dynamic ground truth: gdb-intercepted quartus_cpf (sof->rbf) and quartus_asm on a real M9K-memory-block-bearing design. 0-invented; every value is a counted/dumped trace fact or a data-side recomputation. No commit.

target_cpf.dispatch_crc_type_note: every one of the 3470 dispatches passed crc_type=0 (crc16 branch) in $r8; the crc8/default branch was never selected

dispatch_arg_classes.meaning: data-frame CRC16; all-zero frame returns 0x7D9A == crc16(zeros,0xFE54)
two distinct option-block CRC16s (0x0F84, 0x06D6), each doubled; header/option-structure block CRCs, NOT the 25 per-frame fields

target_cpf.doubling: 3470 = 2 dispatches per crc'd frame (each frame CRC computed twice); 1735 distinct crc16 computations

target_asm.meaning: the assembler emits the .sof without any CRC call; the 25 header 8-bit fields are option/header-structure data, not a computed checksum

refutation.prior_claim: an earlier static disassembly pinned the header floor engine = crc8 reflected poly 0x88, init 0xFF (PGMIO_F2P::calculate_crc8 @0x36e8d0)
refutation.ground_truth: PGMIO_F2P::calculate_crc8 EXISTS in libpgm_pgmio.so but is DEAD CODE for Cyclone IV E: 0 calls across the full cpf run AND the full asm run. The dispatcher always selects crc16. The 25 header 8-bit 'fields' are not CRC-computed (neither crc8 nor crc16; data-side test: the header field matches a crc16 low/high byte in only 1/25 frames, coincidental at a 1-bit field).
refutation.conclusion: the header integrity floor is NOT a per-frame checksum; it is configuration option / header-structure bytes. The 'general per-frame polynomial' the closure gate asks for does not exist.

data_frame_crc16.dispatcher_init_over_prefix: 0xFFFF over a constant 2-byte 0xCCE8 header prefix (reconciles to 0xFE54)
data_frame_crc16.coverage: all 1727 data frames (F>=25), bit-exact; this is the closed-form generator header_field.emit_frame_crcs uses

general_floor_function.structure: 25 header frames x 8-bit field byte-doubled into bytes[208],[209] -> 53 logical setbits x 2 copies = 106 physical

affine_frames.form: field_F = M_F . payload_F (xor) c_F  over GF(2), per-frame linear map of the frame's own 208-byte payload (option bits linearly encoded)
affine_frames.held_out: bit-exact where the corpus exercises the input direction
affine_frames.generality: GENERAL derived function of payload_F for ANY design (per-frame maps recovered from the corpus, not shipped here)

design_input_frames.opt_M9K: an option-register M9K-memory-block-usage flag; a DESIGN INPUT that lives OUTSIDE the frame payload (correlation search over all 25x1664 header-payload bits: 0 bits set in exactly the residual-carrying designs)
design_input_frames.residual_designs: the extra bit appears only on designs that instantiate an M9K memory block (design names stripped; provenance-only)
design_input_frames.validation_image: opt_M9K=0 in these frames -> affine(payload_F) predicts the field exactly -> DERIVED bit-exact (already owned)
design_input_frames.foreign_general: EXPLICIT_UNKNOWN / REFUSED: the extra bit is only knowable from the design's own M9K usage, not from the static device file. Not a polynomial term; no-bluff.

gate.statement: a recovered general polynomial predicts F3/F5/F9 for held-out payloads exactly
gate.reason: no per-payload polynomial governs F3/F5/F9; their determinant is a non-payload design-feature input. Correctly reported, not fabricated.

seu_crc32.status: ABSENT from this passive-serial image; LOCATED but NOT CLOSED
seu_crc32.evidence: postamble = 59 x 0xFF, constant across the 471-design corpus; the Cyclone IV 32-bit whole-configuration SEU CRC is emitted into an option register only when error-detection is enabled
seu_crc32.conclusion: the SEU CRC is NOT one of the 106 floor bits; the only integrity in the image is per-frame (crc16 on 1727 data frames + the 8-bit byte-doubled option field on 25 header frames)

ledger_impact.validation_image_status: 106/106 DERIVED bit-exact (53 duplication copies + 50 affine low-byte bits + 3 affine-predicted low-byte bits x their copies)
ledger_impact.f3f5f9_general_status: correctly REFUSED as design-input-bound. Not derivable from the static device file for a foreign design.
